Upgrade your spa, compare weekly buffs and collect Sparkle Tatari.

How Sparkly Spa works

Open your own spa or visit a friend’s spa to give your T4 Tatari stat bonuses and daily Sparkle progress. Upgrade an active spa through four levels to improve its buffs. Two special effects rotate weekly for newly opened spas.

FeatureHow to access it
Sparkly SpaThe spa feature unlocks after obtaining a T4 Tatari. Spend Spa Soap to open your spa.
Spa StationOwn a T4 Tatari and have a friend with an open spa, then request a visit.
Eligible TatariBuffs apply to your T4 Tatari. Sparkle progress also requires permanent Glitter and an available Sparkle appearance.
Active spaYour Tatari can use one spa at a time. Switching to another spa replaces your own active benefits.

Spa Soap and upgrades

ActionCost / effect
Open a spa100 Spa Soap · 7 days
Level 1 → 220 Spa Soap
Level 2 → 330 Spa Soap
Level 3 → 430 Spa Soap
Fully upgrade one opening80 Spa Soap in upgrades · 180 including opening
Base capacity40 trainers

Sandy Maze Goldrush MVP rewards give 180, 150, 120 or 100 Spa Soap for league ranks I–IV. Other Soap offers depend on shop availability.

Upgrading keeps the same closing time. Each new opening starts at Level 1. Upgrades do not reset daily trigger counts or change yesterday’s settled Sparkle progress.

Spa buffs by level

Every newly opened spa has fixed ATK, HP, DEF and Sparkle progress buffs, plus the current pair of weekly specials. Expand each effect to compare all four levels. Daily limits are shared across spas and upgrades.

Buffs below T4: Spa stat bonuses normally require T4. Only apply bonuses to a lower-tier Tatari when your active Spa explicitly grants that exception. The Tatari Stats Calculator has an advanced override for this case; leave it off otherwise.

Hosts and guests

Host your own spa. Open it with Spa Soap, then upgrade it while active. The special-buff pair is locked when you open it and stays the same until it expires, including across a weekly rotation.

Choose a friend’s spa. The Spa Station shows available buffs, spa level and time remaining. Guests share the owner’s special-buff pair and benefit from upgrades immediately. Your Tatari can use only one spa at a time.

Friends can enter directly when the owner enables free joining. Otherwise, request approval. Leaving, being removed or expiry ends the active benefits. Switching spas and upgrading do not reset daily trigger counts.

Goldrush discount stacking. example : 3% Vanguard discount and 10% active spa discount combine to 13%.
The values above already include the host bonus. Do not double them again. Final combat stats also depend on other bonuses.

Weekly buff rotation

The calendar lists the weekly special pair for Monday through Sunday. Opening a spa locks that pair for its entire session; upgrading changes its strength, not its combination. A rotation affects newly opened spas only.

Seven days from opening. If you open your Spa on Sunday, it keeps Sunday’s special buffs until it expires the following Sunday, even if the rotation changes midweek. Upgrading strengthens the locked buffs without extending the timer. Reopening starts a new session with the rotation then in effect.

Nov 9, 2026 – Nov 15, 2026Double Bento output + Damage dealt
Nov 16, 2026 – Nov 22, 2026Glitter Fruit probability + Boss damage

This is the opening schedule, not a live reading of your account. An existing spa can still have the previous pair. Review the opening preview before spending Soap.

Sparkle Tatari and daily progress

  1. Keep your chosen spa active at the end of the UTC day. Sparkle progress is a fixed buff at all four upgrade levels.
  2. Claim the resulting 50 points the next day. Unclaimed daily progress expires; the final spa day can still be claimed after natural expiry.
  3. Select a T4 Tatari with permanent Glitter unlocked and Sparkle appearances available.
  4. Every 100 points on that Tatari unlocks a random appearance. Progress is tracked separately for each Tatari.
Where you are when unlockingStandardRare
Your own active spa80%20%
A friend’s spa / otherwise100%0%

Duplicate Sparkle appearances convert into +1 Glitter Fruit. Each supported Tatari has five Standard and two Rare appearances. Sparkle appearances are cosmetic; the Spa’s temporary buffs are separate.

Useful habits

  • Choose the right weekly pair. Feeding, Goldrush, Bento crafting and combat favor different special buffs.
  • Upgrade early. Upgrades improve the remaining session without extending it; the level resets when you open again.
  • Check your active spa. Owning a spa does not mean its buffs remain active while visiting another one.
  • Claim daily progress promptly. Missing the next-day claim window loses that day’s progress.
  • Use the actual guest values. Combat buffs provide 60% strength for guests; noncombat buffs retain their full effect. Compare friends’ available sets at the Spa Station before choosing.

Check your active spa

The weekly schedule describes newly opened spas. Your active spa’s displayed buffs, level and closing time determine its current benefits.
